verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server documents that connected AI assistants can "Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data" [asana-docs-36], which approximates AI-drafted status summaries from workspace activity. AI Teammates and Asana Dash ('AI Chief of Staff') are described only generically, with no mention of status updates. The status-update API tutorial is a developer building block for reading updates, not an AI drafting feature, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: a documented native AI feature that drafts project or initiative status updates from recent activity, explicit coverage of initiative or portfolio-level updates, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
